title: Final Frequency Bound
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the inequality for the lowest oscillation frequency, ω_0^2, in terms of the inner product.

title: Comparison with Real Answer
description: Important Criteria: The student should compare their derived bound with the actual frequency result of ω_0^2 ≈ (18.956)T_0/(μ_0a^2).

title: Correct Use of Inner Product
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly define and use the inner product involving the mass density μ(x) and the wave function.

title: Boundary Conditions
description: Important Criteria: The student should mention that the boundary conditions lead to the orthogonality of the wave functions.

title: Integration Steps
description: Optional Criteria: The student should show clear steps in integrating the functions involved in the variational principle.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must avoid common mistakes such as incorrect boundary conditions or misapplying the variational principle.

title: Mass Density Application
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly apply the given mass density μ(x) = μ_0(x/a) in their calculations.

title: Final Expression Clarity
description: Optional Criteria: The student should present the final expressions clearly and concisely, ensuring all variables are defined.
